messages:
harry: meet Miso, the office hedgehog. found a warm shoebox and decided to be adorable. pic: https://i.imgur.com/MisoSnug.jpg :hedgehog:
meena: omg the tiny quill hat. is that a smile?? :sparkling_heart:
jord: flat out stealing my heart. also please tell me hedgehogs are allowed in the breakroom (asking for reasons). :pleading_face:
harry: short rules: only supervised visits, no lamps too close, and absolutely no loud vacuuming near the shoebox. he is sensitive.
taylor: can confirm: i tried to pet and got a very dignified sniff followed by a slow roll. full approval. :white_check_mark:
meena: poll: should we put a tiny nameplate on Miso's box? reply yes/no
jord: yes. suggested nameplate text: "Miso, Chief Nap Officer."
ops-bot: reminder: please review the office pet policy before bringing animals to shared spaces. Also FYI, allergies? please speak up. :information_source:
harry: short audio: tiny snuffle and then a sneeze noise (highly photogenic), will upload to the thread later.
taylor: file-sharing note: uploaded a 6s slo-mo of Miso curling into a perfect donut: https://drive.company.com/miso-donut.mp4
meena: caption idea: "When your sprint turns into a snuggle sprint." :rofl:
jord: bribe strategy: Miso loves bits of cooked sweet potato. I will bring offerings on Friday.
taylor: remote-friendly option: i'll set up a little webcam for the "Miso cam" during lunch so folks can vote for cutest curl.
harry: final picture: Miso tucked under a post-it blanket. verdict: we are all useless and must attend to hedgehog needs. pic: https://i.imgur.com/MisoPostIt.jpg :sweat_smile:
